description.p: A pen-first notes app for drawing tablets and 2-in-1s: write by hand in notebooks, sections and pages, as quickly as on paper.

ul.li: Notebooks, sections and pages in a sidebar, with drag and drop
Pressure-sensitive ink, highlighters and an eraser that cuts strokes
Hold the pen still to snap a stroke to a line, arrow or circle
Radial menu from a pen side button, lasso selection
Text boxes with inline LaTeX math
Infinite canvas or paper sheets with lined, grid or dotted backgrounds

description.p: Notes are plain folders and JSON files in Documents/Ratchet, so any sync tool works.

screenshot.caption: Notes with ink, shapes and math

description.p: Linux builds are now a Flatpak, which runs on any distro and updates itself.
